page.notes: The Syriac words (in the first paragraph, in section VII and in the two italic glosses "Amictus" and "Epho") are not legible letter by letter at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible. The right edge of the scan is cropped: words cut off there are given only as far as they are visible and marked [?]. Hyphens at line ends are not visible in the cropped area, so split words are joined whole (imperfectum, exemplari, Confer, verissimum, ordinatur). The asterisk after "comperies." is a printer's ornament and is left out.
